summary: Phase 4 (hybrid dynamic AI task generation) validated end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases green in ~47s (real Gemini) covering smart=true generation for math_prof/derivative with source traceability, smart=false regression, answer→mastery integrity, admin /admin/questions?ai_generated=true visibility+shape (well-formed single_choice, verified=false, source_doc_title=профмат, source_page=13, source_context populated), verify toggle, and phase 1-3 regression (admin task list, extended_response excluded from /practice/start, /ai/chat still works). Frontend: /app/practice with subject Математика профиль → topic Производная → 'Добавить задания от ИИ' toggle (data-testid=practice-smart-toggle/practice-smart-checkbox) → Начать (start-practice-btn) shows loader label 'Фили создаёт задания…', then QuestionRunner opens with a freshly generated ЕГЭ-level task (e.g. 'Тренировочное задание: … P(R)=3600R/(R+6)²'). /app/admin > Задания with 'ИИ-сгенерированные' filter (task-filter-ai=true) lists ИИ tasks with ИИ badge + 'не проверено'; preview opens task-preview-source block containing 'Сгенерировано ИИ · не проверено', 'Источник: профмат, стр. 13' and full retrieved context snippet. Currently 7 AI-generated tasks in DB, all with full traceability. No blocking bugs.

minor.issue: generate_and_store_tasks swallows all AIService.generate_question errors via bare `except: return None`. Real Gemini failures are invisible (no logger.exception). Graceful-degradation intent is fine, but observability is zero.
n concurrent Gemini calls via asyncio.gather with no per-call timeout — a hung generator holds the whole start_practice request until the client HTTP timeout.

No cap on how many AI tasks accumulate for a (subject_id, topic_id, difficulty) tuple. Every smart click may generate 1–5 more rows into `questions`, so the collection grows without bound; no dedup on question text.

Generated tasks are hard-coded type='single_choice' even though existing seeded derivative tasks use type='numeric' and the AI often produces numeric-style stems ('Найдите точку максимума…'). This forces the answer into an option index and defeats numeric grading.

Validation only checks (question, len(options)>=2, 0<=answer<len(options)). It does not deduplicate against existing prompts, does not enforce distinct options, and does not sanity-check answer text length — a task with 2 identical options ('A','A', answer=0) will persist.

generate_and_store_tasks picks `src = next(text-source) or sources[0]` and reuses that same doc/page for every generated task in the batch, even when different snippets from different pages were retrieved. Traceability is at batch granularity, not per-task.

issues: 'Всего: 127' counter shows the total task count, ignoring the currently active filter (task-filter-ai=true) — misleading when a filter is applied.
Only a text label 'Фили создаёт задания…' is shown for a 20-60s wait; no spinner/progress indicator, and no way to cancel.

action_items: Add logger.exception around AIService.generate_question failures in routes_practice.generate_and_store_tasks so real Gemini errors surface.
Wrap each generate_question call in asyncio.wait_for(...) with a sensible per-task timeout (e.g. 30s) so one hung generation does not block the whole /practice/start response.
Deduplicate generated tasks against existing question text for the same topic to prevent unbounded DB growth on repeated smart clicks.
Preserve per-task traceability: pick the specific source snippet used to seed each generated question rather than reusing sources[0] for the whole batch.
Consider allowing the generator to emit type='numeric' when the answer is a single number, matching the seeded derivative task style; or filter such prompts out.
Make the 'Всего: N' header in AdminTasks reflect filtered count, or rename it to 'Всего в базе: N'.
Add a spinner/animation next to 'Фили создаёт задания…' during smart-mode wait.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_practice.generate_and_store_tasks — silent bare `except: return None` hides ALL Gemini generation failures; at minimum log with logger.exception, ideally also increment a metric.
No per-task timeout on Gemini generation; a single hung upstream call blocks the whole /practice/start.
Traceability is stored at batch level (single src reused for every generated task in a run); loses fidelity when kb returned multiple pages.
Generated tasks are always persisted as single_choice — the derivative topic already uses numeric type in seeded data; the two won't interop cleanly at grading time.
